title: AVO Provider Manifest
description: Manifest for an AVO provider workspace (providers/<name>/avo.provider.json). A provider is a publishing destination/identity (YouTube channel, TikTok account, Instagram profile, ...). Provider identity, design, logo and brand live in-repo; ALL media stays EXTERNAL — the manifest stores paths only, never media.

$schema.description: Optional path/URL to this schema for editor validation.

name.description: Provider slug. Lowercase kebab-case; must match the providers/<name>/ directory name.

description.description: Short description of the channel/account and its content.

scope.description: What this provider is scoped to within a brand or channel (e.g. '16:9 long-form tutorials', '9:16 Shorts clips'). Defines ai-memory learning boundaries and format expectations.

platformUrl.description: Optional canonical URL for the channel or account (YouTube, TikTok, etc.).

media.description: EXTERNAL media roots. These are filesystem paths ONLY — no media is ever committed. Paths are gitignored at their source location.

rawRoot.description: External folder that holds this provider's raw footage projects. Absolute path (may be OS-specific). Never inside this repo.

editRoot.description: Optional external folder for edit/working output. Defaults to <rawRoot>/edit when omitted.

assets.description: Optional default asset locations for this provider. sfx/music/inserts/graphics are EXTERNAL paths. logos MAY reference the in-repo providers/<name>/logo directory.

logos.description: Logo location. Usually the in-repo path 'providers/<name>/logo'.

transcription.description: Provider default transcription settings. Overrides avo.config.json transcription.language for this provider.

language.description: faster-whisper language code (e.g. 'pt', 'en', 'es'). Chosen at setup; not fixed.

restoration_default_pct.description: Default noise-reduction strength (0-100) for speech-led content. EDL overrides win.

loudness.description: Provider default loudness intent and channel reference targets.

default_intent.description: Default loudness resolution intent when project/EDL do not override.

channel_standard.description: Channel-owned integrated loudness, true peak, and LRA reference.

note.description: Human note — not an official platform requirement.

brand.description: Pointers to this provider's in-repo brand material.

design.description: Path to the provider DESIGN.md (relative to repo root).

palette.description: Path to a palette.json under brand/ (relative to repo root).

routingOverrides.description: Per-provider overrides that patch the shared avo.config.json routing (jobs, confidence, transcription). Same shape as avo.config.json; only the keys to override need to be present.
